title: RH Weil Matrix Positivity Certificate Format v1
description: Authoritative contract for exact rational interval mathematical proof certificates.

format.description: Identifier of the certificate specification version.

claim.description: Human-readable description of the mathematical claim certified by this artifact.

num.description: Numerator of the exact support half-width T.

den.description: Denominator of the exact support half-width T.

type.description: Type of orthonormal or polynomial basis functions.

dimension.description: Number of basis functions in the finite block.

domain.description: Domain of definition, typically '[-T, T]' or '[-1, 1]'.

dimension.description: Dimension N of the N x N finite-block matrix.

constants.description: Bundle of transcendental constants with verified outward rational interval bounds.

is_symmetric.description: Flag indicating that the matrix is mathematically self-adjoint/symmetric.

entries.description: Row-major or coordinate array of all N x N rational interval entries.

lo_num.description: Numerator of lower rational interval endpoint.

lo_den.description: Denominator of lower rational interval endpoint (must be > 0).

hi_num.description: Numerator of upper rational interval endpoint.

hi_den.description: Denominator of upper rational interval endpoint (must be > 0).

type.description: Type of infinite-dimensional remainder or tail bound applied.

internal_ldl_verification.description: Optional generator-side LDL check metadata (informational only; verifier recomputes independently).

generator.description: Module or script identifier that generated the certificate.

flint_version.description: Underlying FLINT version used for enclosure arithmetic.

prec_bits.description: Bit precision used during rigorous integration and interval evaluation.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of artifact creation.
